params.pricePerGas: Price in token's smallest unit per gas unit.
params.token: The ERC20 token address. Set pricePerGas to 0 to disable.

deposit().notice: Deposit ETH into the EntryPoint for paymaster gas sponsorship.

getDeposit().notice: Query the paymaster's deposit balance on the EntryPoint.

postOp(uint8,bytes,uint256,uint256).notice: Post-operation handler. For token payment mode, collects ERC20 tokens.

setSponsoredAccount(address,bool).notice: Approve or revoke ETH sponsorship for an account.

setTokenGasPrice(address,uint256).notice: Configure an ERC20 token for gas payment with a price per gas unit.

tokenDebt(address,address).notice: Total gas cost owed by each account in each token (settled in postOp).

tokenGasPrice(address).notice: ERC20 tokens accepted for gas payment (mode 2).         token => price per gas unit in token's smallest denomination.

validatePaymasterUserOp((address,uint256.notice: Validate a paymaster-sponsored UserOperation.         paymasterAndData format: [paymaster(20)] [mode(1)] [token(20, mode 2 only)]

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw from the paymaster's EntryPoint deposit.
